title: Most Properties are Undecidable for Transitive Tense Logics
summary: A logics' property is decidable in a class of logics if there exists an algorithm that decides whether a finitely axiomatizable logic in the class has the property. Many properties are undecidable for bimodal logics but decidable for linear tense logics, which leads to a general question on how the interactions of modalities affect the decidability of properties.
